claims.text: The experiments evaluated the performance of hotel2vec embeddings by analyzing learning curves and the effects of hyperparameters such as the number of negative samples and learning rate.

Empirical experiments were conducted to compare various optimization algorithms and their impact on model performance, revealing that SGD with exponential learning rate decay was particularly effective.
The evaluation included measuring cosine similarity between markets to assess the effectiveness of the session-only and enriched models in capturing market similarities.
